system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Cortical Stack, Echolocation, Enhanced Hearing, Oxygen Reserve
system.advantages: +5 INT, +5 SOM, +5 to one other aptitude of the player’s choice, +50 Swimming skill, Ramming Attack (1d10 DV),
system.disadvantages: Neo-porpoises lack a sense of smell
system.description:
Neo-porpoises are smaller but very similar to neo-dolphins and are much like their baseline relatives. They average 2.5 meters in length.

Notes: Non-Human Biochemistry trait

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 67.
